title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.28
subtitle: Readable solver list and clearer pinning.

highlights.title: Readable solver list
highlights.description: The Release list in Preferences shows correct AETHER and GAIA names again.

highlights.title: Clear pinning modes
highlights.description: Soft pins may yield to cloth and contact; Hard pins hold exactly. The tooltips now say so.

highlights.title: Two solver engines
highlights.description: AETHER, the official solver, and GAIA, the PolyWorks build, as introduced in 2.9.27.
